create.name: Rev. Sue Frederick
create.bio:
Rev. Sue Frederick is an ordained Unity minister, numerologist and intuitive based in Scottsdale, Arizona, who has studied numerology since 1980. She also works as a past-life and between-lives soul regression therapist, and describes herself as a channel for angelic guidance and for messages from departed loved ones. Before this work she was a corporate vice president and magazine editor, led Outward Bound survival courses and taught at the University of Colorado and Naropa University. Her outlook was shaped by the early death of her husband and by what she calls three shared-death experiences.

She teaches what she calls Sacred Numerology: reading the numbers in a birth date as a map of soul purpose, relationships and timing cycles, alongside angelic guidance, meditation and sacred writing. Her books include I See Your Dream Job, I See Your Soul Mate, Bridges to Heaven, Through a Divine Lens, the Angel Up! series and Angels & Numbers. She teaches live Zoom courses and self-paced video classes, runs a Patreon group, hosts the Mystical Conversations podcast and YouTube channel, and teaches on The Shift Network. She is an honorary board member of Helping Parents Heal.

books.title: Angels & Numbers: The Sacred Language of Divine Guidance
books.author: Sue Frederick
books.description: Her newest book, combining Sacred Numerology with angelic guidance. It shows how to calculate and read your core numbers and how she sees angels and numbers working together as guidance through life's cycles.

books.title: Through a Divine Lens: Practices to Quiet Your Ego and Align with Your Soul
books.author: Sue Frederick
books.description: Published by Park Street Press in 2023. It offers practices for stepping back from the ego's view of events and seeing your life from the soul's perspective, drawing on numerology, soul agreements and her shared-death experiences.

books.title: I See Your Dream Job: A Career Intuitive Shows You How to Discover What You Were Put on Earth to Do
books.author: Sue Frederick
books.description: Published by St. Martin's Press in 2009. It uses numerology and intuition to help readers find work that fits their life purpose.

books.title: I See Your Soul Mate: An Intuitive's Guide to Finding and Keeping Love
books.author: Sue Frederick
books.description: A guide to relationships through numerology and intuition, looking at what each partnership is meant to teach and how to find and keep a loving relationship.

books.title: Bridges to Heaven: True Stories of Loved Ones on the Other Side
books.author: Sue Frederick
books.description: A collection of true accounts of contact with departed loved ones, with her reflections on what they suggest about life after death.

books.title: Sacred Numerology: Workbook - Second Edition
books.author: Sue Frederick, Gene Malowany
books.description: A revised workbook for working out and interpreting your own numbers, covering life path, soul purpose and timing cycles. Written with Gene Malowany.

books.title: Angel Up! The Complete Ascension Trilogy: Three Books in One
books.author: Sue Frederick
books.description: Brings together the three Angel Up! books in one volume: The Angels' Guide to Ascension, its study companion and its journal. The series presents channelled angelic teachings on choosing love as a daily practice.

books.title: Angel Up! Study Guide: A Sacred Companion to Angel Up! The Angels' Guide to Ascension
books.author: Sue Frederick
books.description: A companion workbook to Angel Up! The Angels' Guide to Ascension, with questions and exercises for individual or group study.

books.title: Angel Up! Journal: 33 Days of Angelic Wisdom
books.author: Sue Frederick
books.description: A 33-day guided journal in the Angel Up! series, with a short angelic teaching and reflective writing for each day.

courses.title: Angels & Numbers: The Sacred Language of Divine Guidance in 2027
courses.description: A seven-week live Zoom course based on her book Angels & Numbers. You learn to calculate and interpret your core numbers, explore soul agreements and divine timing, and look at the 11 energy she sees in 2027. Tuition includes a workbook and recordings.

courses.title: Angelic Ministry Ascension Program
courses.description: A self-guided programme of seven recorded class videos and a workbook. It sets out her teaching on living from your highest, most loving self as what she calls an angelic minister of light.

courses.title: Sacred Numerology as Portal to Your Soul's Purpose, Soul Agreements & Connection to Departed Loved Ones
courses.description: A self-guided class of five videos with a workbook. Sue shows how she uses numbers to read soul purpose and soul agreements and as a way of connecting with loved ones who have died.

courses.title: Navigating Soul Agreements in Relationship Using Sacred Numerology
courses.description: A self-guided video class with a workbook on the soul agreements behind your relationships, including those with loved ones in spirit. It looks at what each relationship is helping you learn.

free_resources.title: Soul Path Calculator
free_resources.description: A free online calculator on her website for working out your soul path number from your birth date. A video on her YouTube channel explains how to use it to read your soul mission.

free_resources.title: Using Sacred Numerology to Understand Life Purpose
free_resources.description: A free download linked from her About page introducing how she uses Sacred Numerology to understand life purpose.
